text:
When aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to a solution of a metal ion, a grey-green precipitate
forms, which dissolves in excess to form a dark green solution.
What is the identity of the metal ion?
chromium(III)
A
B
iron(II)
C
iron(III)
copper(II)
D
subject: Chemistry
